strategy.primary: Villain-copy combat value: Loki attacks safely, copies the best Villain for the combat (enters, static and combat-damage text, not attack triggers), and connecting Villains draw cards.
strategy.secondary: Keep the temporary copies (The Master, Multiplied; Sundial of the Infinite), double Loki's trigger (Roaming Throne, Hall of Echoes, Titan of Littjara), and grind with Villain tribal draw (Kindred Discovery) and premium Grixis interaction.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Loki, the Deceiver
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever Loki attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target Villain you control, except it isn't legendary and it's an Illusion in addition to its other types. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the next end step.
Whenever one or more Villains you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.

identity.why: Attack-time Villain copy plus Villain combat draw.
Becomes a second Loki without the legend rule.
Unblockable warded Villain that makes hasty Apes.
